OEM IMPORTED PRODUCTS: In case of imported products, OEM or Authorized Seller of OEM should have a registered office in India to provide after sales service support in India. The certificate to this effect should be submitted. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Technical Specification of Type-I and Type-II Water Purification Part 1: High Quality Pre-Filter: Pre-filter for attaching before main water filtr ation units to counter the feed water contamination. Pre-filter should be manufa ctured by same equipment OEM with following specifications: high quality pre-fi lter with low pressure switch cuts off system which can able to take care high T DS up to 5000 ppm. Apart from pre-filters two separate model should be there for Type-I and Type II systems. Part 2: Lab Grade Water Purification System(Type II): Feed water accepta nce capability specifications for main unit: (a) Conductivity: <0.2μS/cm at 25°C (water output) (b) Resistivity: Typically 5-15 mega Ohms (c) flow rate – 3 Ltrs/hr (d) TOC: < 30 ppb (e) Fouling Index(SDI): upto 12. (f) Free Chlorine: upto 3 ppm. (g) Temperature-5-35ºC. Type II water should meet 1) System should have facility to control remotely with the help of software inter face. All parameters like pressure, current, water rejection %, water product quality should be monitored in desktop or laptop. 2) Must have automatic electrodeionization module. 3) EDI must have carbon beads at cathode which doesn’t require extra pre softe ning cartridges for better water quality or IR-control with proactive gas filling

under argon. 4) No of conductivity cell in Type-II to ensure the Input & Output water quality-3 Nos. 5) Inside Type-II system inbuilt pre-treatment Cartridge: 0.5 Micron filter, anti-sc aling compounds and RFID tag must be in this system. 6) Pre-treatment pack contains silver-impregnated activated carbon which prev ents the proliferation of bacteria present in tap water; anti scaling compound s must eliminate hardness and protect the RO membrane against oxidation, scaling and plugging. 7) RFID Tag for traceability of per-treatment cartridge and every litre throughpu t water volume should be seen on computer when connected through LAN. T he record for date of cartridge installation must be available on computer. 8) RO reject water recovery upto 50% before RO conductivity cell to know the % rejection of RO 9) In Type II system:- The following parameter must be visible on system LCD/L ED display: a) Tap water feed conductivity. b) RO feed water conductivity. c) RO water temperature. d) RO pump pressure. e) RO % rejection value. f) RO permeate water conductivity. g) Tank level 10) 3 way solenoid valve- RO permeate is diverted to drain until the quality me ets expectations. There must be recovery loop in II system to save wastage of r ejected water. 11) Warranty in years: Minimum 5Years Storage Reservoir: Tank capacity: 50 Liters Part 3: Ultra-Pure Water (Type I) should meet: Typical Water Delivery flow Rate: 2L/min Ultrapure Water Resistivity (MΩ.cm at 25ºC) : 18.2 Conductivity: ≤ 0.055µs/cm at 25ºC water particulates: No particles with a size > 0.22 mm TOC(ppb): ≤5 (TOC indicator should be there) Microorganisms (cfu/mL): End filter<0.01

Pyrogen Levels (EU/mL): <0.001 RNase Level(pg/mL): <1 DNase Level (pg/mL): <5 Protease (ug/mL): <0.15 Recirculation loop:1 No 1) The water system has a built-in UV lamp with emission at 185 nm and 254n m wavelength. The lamp will operate for 2 years without replacement in orde r to reduce operating costs and the maintenance procedures. 2) Two numbers of polishing cartridge of mixed bed resins should be there in Ty pe-I system . 3) The system will have a choice of minimum 6 point-of use final filter on the w ater dispenser to support different applications. Submit details of all minimu m six. 4) The water Point-of-Delivery can be installed on a wall-mounted support for ful l flexibility of installation. The wall mounted configuration where the HMI and the Point of Delivery are fixed on the wall to a distance up to 3 meters. POD dispensing experience should be the same whatever the installation of the w ater purification system. 5) At the Point-of-Delivery, basic information on water quality or any alert / alar m information should be shared. 6) 7” large or bigger touchscreen with bright color LED/LCD display compatible with gloves and wet or dry hands. 7) Only one single inline photo-oxidation UV lamp allows both to reduce organic s in ultra-pure water and to measure TOC level. 8) Inline TOC indicator is being measure at the point of use and displayed on th e touchscreen after each dispense (Real time TOC monitoring). 9) UV lamp should be made up of mercury free or low pressure Mercury. 10) The water purification system is able to report the resistivity and conductivity in both temperature compensated and non-temperature compe nsated formats. The resistivity meters are able to verified and calibrated on- site. 11) The system can be connected to the local network via an Ethernet port and has a USB key port. 12) Must have possibility for connecting extra dispenser for ICP-MS application. 13) Water dispensing reports record all with dispensing parameters (water quali ty and volume, data and time). 14) The volumetric water dispensing to deliver a specific water volume from 10 0ml to 25L automatically ( with 100ml incremental). A quick volumetric dispe nsing is also accessible from a pre-set menu of customizable water volumes. 15) Installation and warranty should be taken care by OEM service engineer. 16) CE certificates for Type 1 & Type II system specific for make/model need to be submitted along with tender. 17) ISO Certificate: 13485 & 9001 or latest 18) Must have possibility for Type I water with boron <0.50ppb. 19) Warranty in years: Minimum 5Years 20) Demonstration of equipment and training should be provided after completi

ng supplies before acceptance. 21) Should be availability of toll free facility for technical support maintained by OEM or authorized agencies. 22) Should be provided number of installations of the machines in Central/State /PSU Govt Hospitals. . 3.
